title: MemberRegistered
description: The `MemberRegistered` interface: member ID, name, email and joined at, as `MemberService.register` publishes it.

title: ToolAdded
description: The `ToolAdded` interface: tool ID, name, description (empty when none) and added at, as `ToolService.add` publishes it.

title: DamageReported
description: The `DamageReported` interface: tool ID, note and reported at, as `ToolService.reportDamage` publishes it. The time is the event's; the tools table keeps only the note.

title: ToolRepaired
description: The `ToolRepaired` interface: tool ID and repaired at, as `ToolService.markRepaired` publishes it.

title: LoanOpened
description: The `LoanOpened` interface: loan ID, member, tool, borrowed at and due date, as `LendingService.borrow` publishes it.

title: ToolReturned
description: The `ToolReturned` interface: loan ID, member, tool, returned at, condition, note (null when none) and late, as `LendingService.return` publishes it. `EventDispatcher`, in the same file, publishes every event to the handlers subscribed to it, in process, after the raising transaction commits.
